title: Uwo Imbere ye Ibimenyetso by'Ubwami Byinamye
intro: Urugendo rutangaje rutegereje abatinyuka gukemura iri banga. Mu byerekezo by'Ibyahishuwe, hari umwami wahuye n'umuhanuzi wahinduraga ubwoko bwose. Uyu muntu yategekaga ku ntebe ye ya kure, ayobowe n'imigenzo ya kera, kugeza igihe ukuri kw'Imana kwahinduye umutegetsi n'ubwami iteka ryose. Ese uzahishura uwo muntu utangaje ufite inkuru ihuza ibintu bidasanzwe n'ibikomeye?
clues: Nayoboye igihugu gikize hakurya y'amazi ya kure, kizwiho ubusitani bwacu n'ingoro ndende.
Ububasha bwanjye bwari buhanitse, nyamara ubwami bukomeye bwaje kugerageza kubaho kwacu n'uko turi.
Inyoni nto yari ifite ubutumwa budasanzwe, maze ibitangaza byakurikiyeho bishengura ibitekerezo byanjye byose ku byerekeye imbaraga.
Igihe nabonaga intebe y'ubwami ihinduka imbere y'amaso yanjye, namenye ko nta muntu n'umwe ushobora kugira ubushobozi nk'ubwo.
Natangaje ku mugaragaro ko nemera kugandukira Umwami umwe rukumbi w’ijuru n’isi, nsiga ibyo nakundaga byose.
Twe, nk'igihugu, twaretse gusenga izuba rya kera maze twemera ukuri kwahinduye byose.

trial.label: Ikigeragezo Gikomeye

Intambara yo kurwanya ingabo z'Intumwa Sulayman
Imyaka mirongo itatu y'amapfa akomeye n'ingorane
trial.answer: Kwakira ubutumwa bw'amayobera binyuze ku nyoni idasanzwe

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Nashakanye n'Umuhanuzi Sulayman mba i Yerusalemu
Twagandukiye Allah kandi twakira ukwemera nyakuri
Nasubiye ku ntebe yanjye y'ubwami nkomeza gutegeka nk'uko byari bimeze mbere
Ishyanga ryafashwe rijyanwa mu bundi bwami
outcome.answer: Twagandukiye Allah kandi twakira ukwemera nyakuri

arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verse: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]." (38:32)
